name: Andou Aoi
source:
Misae's son, a boy attending the same academy.

He met Chris through an introduction and is one of the members joining the Madam Club together.

He has a laid-back personality and is an otaku-type boy whose trademark is his glasses.

His gentle tone means he gets along well with the protagonist.

He dotes excessively on his mom, to the point where everyone calls him a mama's boy

But he doesn't seem to care at all, sticking firmly to his mom-centric ways. 

[From the [url=https://www.empress-game.com/yukanmadam/]official website[/url]]
